ace1media-ace-1-media:ashbyhq:0487188f-a.description: Pay: CA$60,000.00 - CA$120,000.00 per year Job description: Position: Senior Media Buyer (Remote) Company: Ace1 Media Website: www.ace1m.com http://www.ace1m.com About Ace1 Media: At Ace1 Media, we are a leading digital marketing agency that specializes in search arbitrage, using our deep expertise to drive targeted online traffic and maximize revenue across multiple platforms. embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:673ad01.title: 视频数据标注 & 评测专家 / 负责人
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:673ad01.description: 岗位职责 视频标注 • 设计并落地各类视频标注任务与规范:caption(prompt 与视频内容对齐)、动作(action)、场景(scene)、风格、镜头 / 运镜、时序一致性、ranking / preference、badcase 分类等。 • 搭建标注质检体系:gold set、抽检、多轮 review、一致性(IAA)、reviewer 校准,保障大批量标注质量稳定可迭代。 • 管理标注供应商 / 众包团队,控制交付质量、一致性与返工。 • 根据模型 badcase 持续迭代标注规范(guideline)与标准。 视频评测 • 搭建视频生成评测体系:评测集 / benchmark 构建,评测维度与指标设计(画质、动作自然度、时序一致性、prompt 匹配度、坏帧 / 变形 / 闪烁等),人工 + 自动评测结合。 • 建立 badcase 分类与回流机制,把评测结果转化为可执行的数据补充和标注规范调整。 • 支持多版本模型对比,跟踪数据使用效果与模型改进。 协同 • 与算法团队对接,理解 PT / SFT / RLHF / Eval 各阶段对数据的不同要求,推动数据标准持续迭代。 任职要求 • 3 年以上相关经验,做过视频 / 图像 / 多模态数据的标注或评测(非纯文本 NLP)。 • 亲手做过相关工作,能清楚讲解不同视频标注任务之间的差异和具体做法。 • 熟悉标注质检体系,在 gold set、抽检、IAA、reviewer 校准等机制上至少有一套实操经验。 • 有与算法团队协作、推动 badcase 回流的经验。 • 较强的流程梳理与跨团队沟通能力。 加分项 • 直接做过视频生成 / T2V / VLM / 多模态模型的训练数据或评测。 • 理解 SFT / RLHF,清楚偏好数据与 ranking 在其中的作用。 • 管理过标注供应商 / 众包 / 专家团队,并能把控交付质量。 • 有从 0 到 1 搭建标注或评测流程的经验。

jobgether-jobgether:lever:03da1695-8c23-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:147b1a20-0ffe-.title: Training Specialist, Medical Review Audit – Clinical RN
jobgether-jobgether:lever:147b1a20-0ffe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Training Specialist, Medical Review Audit – Clinical RN based in the United States. This is a specialized clinical training role focused on strengthening the quality and consistency of post-acute medical claims auditing. You will combine hands-on nursing expertise with adult learning and instructional design to develop training for clinical audit professionals. The role has a strong focus on Inpatient Psychiatric Facility (IPF) and Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility (IRF) claims, with additional exposure to Home Health and DME. You will translate complex clinical, regulatory, coding, and payment requirements into practical, audit-ready learning experiences. Your work will directly influence auditor accuracy, productivity, quality outcomes, and the effectiveness of new program implementations. Working closely with operations, QA, compliance, and other stakeholders, you will identify knowledge gaps and build targeted improvement programs. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced RN and healthcare audit professional who enjoys combining clinical subject matter expertise with measurable training outcomes Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive training curricula for clinical audit nurses and associates covering post-acute claims review, documentation, medical necessity, coding, and payer policies. Create structured onboarding, continuing education, competency, remediation, and implementation programs, supported by job aids, reference materials, assessments, and other learning resources. Translate complex clinical and regulatory requirements into clear training content covering areas such as IPF PPS, IRF PPS, DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, level-of-care distinctions, facility billing rules, and related audit concepts. Maintain training content in the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring materials remain accurate, accessible, and effective for remote delivery. Deliver training through virtual classrooms, small-group sessions, and one-to-one formats while adapting delivery to different experience levels. Track training completion, assessment results, audit accuracy, QA outcomes, appeals trends, and other performance indicators to measure program effectiveness. Identify knowledge and performance gaps through audit data, quality results, appeals, and observation, then design and implement targeted remediation plans. Conduct User Acceptance Testing for new audit platform workflows and reporting enhancements and incorporate relevant findings into training programs before launch. Serve as a clinical subject matter expert for IPF and IRF audit requirements, including medical necessity, documentation, payment rules, coding, and level-of-care determinations. Train auditors on IPF requirements such as qualifying psychiatric diagnoses, physician certification and attestation, treatment plans, daily progress notes, safety assessments, and ECT add-on billing. Train auditors on IRF requirements including the 60%/75% compliance rule, pre-admission screening, IRF-PAI timelines, the 3-hour therapy rule and exceptions, interdisciplinary team conferences, individualized care plans, and CMG assignment. Monitor changes to CMS regulations, LCD/NCD criteria, coding guidelines, and clinical standards and proactively update training materials and communicate changes. Partner with operations, QA, compliance, and management to align training with business objectives, client requirements, workflows, and implementation timelines. Provide consultative input into audit platform requirements, workflow design, business rules, process improvements, and medical review initiatives. Requirements Active, unrestricted nursing license in good standing, with no Medicare program sanction or exclusion by OIG. Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Health Information Management, Education, or a related field, or equivalent relevant qualifications.

WHAT YOU’LL DO - Work directly with customers to help them adopt and succeed with Spur’s AI-driven testing platform - Author, maintain, and improve AI-powered test flows for customer applications - Debug failed tests and investigate AI agent behaviors in customer environments - Support pilots and production usage by improving test reliability and coverage - Monitor and track customer activity, engagement and relay product feedback to design and engineering teams - Translate customer intent into effective prompts and workflows - Partner with Account Executives during onboarding, demos, and spurring sessions - Provide clear technical explanations to both technical and non-technical users - Feed real-world learnings back into product and engineering to drive platform improvement - Gradually take full ownership of customer accounts and lead technical conversations WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE - Work at the intersection of AI, QA/test automation, and customer-facing engineering - Shape how AI agents behave in production by designing, debugging, and optimizing tests - Not a static role: you’ll go far beyond supporting software and play a direct part in shaping customer outcomes - Early and deep exposure to both prompt engineering and real-world use cases WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - First 3 months: Shadow Solution Engineers, write and debug tests, support customer pilots, and develop deep understanding of Spur - By 6 months: Independently own customer pilots or accounts, improve coverage and reliability, debug complex issues, and suggest workflow enhancements - By 9–12 months: Operate as a Solution Engineer, lead technical conversations, own customer test strategy, and influence product and AI behavior through customer feedback WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR We value mindset and fundamentals over perfect resumes. Must Have: - 3–4 years experience in Customer Success Roles - Comfort with Technical Concepts - Customer Obsession & Being able to handle multiple accounts and context switch - Strong understanding of web applications and browser behavior - Clear communication skills and empathy for customers - Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, processes, and AI concepts - AI Comfort - We are an AI first company and use AI in every aspect of our workflow and GTM team Nice to Have: - Automation experience with any framework - QA / Testing Experience -

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79189.description: Job Opportunity: Warehouse Associate with Ditsch USA in Cincinnati, OH Looking for a hands-on warehouse role where you can stay active and be part of a team? Need a 1st or 2nd shift opportunity where you can support inventory, shipping, receiving, and keep things moving? If you enjoy fast-paced work and take pride in staying organized and accurate, this could be a great fit! Ditsch USA is looking for Warehouse Associates to join their Cincinnati team on 1st and 2nd shift . In this role, you will support warehouse operations by receiving, shipping, tracking inventory, moving materials, and helping keep production and shipments running safely and efficiently. If you enjoy hands-on work and being part of a strong team, this could be a solid opportunity. Starting pay: $20.50 - $21.50/hour. Why Join Ditsch USA? Competitive starting pay ($20.50 - $21.50/hour) 1st and 2nd shift options available Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match PTO and paid holidays Life insurance and additional benefit options Training and growth opportunities Opportunity to grow into a lead role About the Role As a Warehouse Associate , you will help keep warehouse and production operations running smoothly by supporting inventory, shipments, material movement, and warehouse organization. Able to stand, walk, and move throughout the shift. Comfortable working in warehouse, dock, freezer, and production areas. If you’re looking for a hands-on role where you can stay active, support a team, and grow in a warehouse and manufacturing environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply online today! weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:ce7d7ad2-a85.description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you'll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you'll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we'll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You'll Need - Native or near-native fluency in English - Based in: India - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you'll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply? Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community. 📬 Questions? If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com .
